sentences.zh: 初，則天命河內王武懿宗按思禮之獄。

translations.literal: At first Empress Wu ordered Prince of Henei Wu Yizong to investigate Silun's case.
translations.idiomatic: At first Empress Wu ordered Prince of Henei Wu Yizong to investigate Silun's case.

sentences.zh: 懿宗寬思禮於外，令廣引逆徒。

translations.literal: Yizong kept Silun outside and had him broadly implicate rebellious associates.
translations.idiomatic: Yizong kept Silun outside the prison and had him implicate rebels broadly.

sentences.zh: 而思禮以為得計，從容自若，嘗與相忤者，必引令枉誅。

translations.literal: Silun thought he had succeeded and was calm and at ease; whenever he met one at odds he was sure to have him wrongly executed.
translations.idiomatic: Silun thought himself safe and remained calm; anyone he disliked he had falsely implicated.

sentences.zh: 臨刑猶在外，尚不之覺，及眾人就戮，乃收誅之。

translations.literal: At execution he was still outside and did not yet realize it; only when the multitude went to slaughter was he taken and executed.
translations.idiomatic: At execution he was still outside unaware; only when the crowd went to slaughter was he seized and killed.

sentences.zh: 趙文恪趙文恪者，并州太原人也。

translations.literal: Zhao Wenge. Zhao Wenge was a man of Taiyuan in Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Wenge came from Taiyuan in Bing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隋末，為鷹揚府司馬。

translations.literal: At the end of Sui he was Major of the Hawk-Promotion Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Sui he was Major of the Hawk-Promotion Directorate.

sentences.zh: 義師之舉，授右三統軍。

translations.literal: When the righteous army rose he was made Right Third Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the righteous army rose he was made Right Third Army Commander.

sentences.zh: 武德二年，拜都水監，封新興郡公。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wude he was appointed Director of Waterways and enfeoffed Duke of Xinxing Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Wude year 2 he became Director of Waterways and Duke of Xinxing Commandery.

sentences.zh: 時大亂之後，中州少馬，遇突厥蕃市牛馬以資國用。

translations.literal: After great disorder, the central plains had few horses; they encountered Turk markets trading cattle and horses to supply state use.
translations.idiomatic: After the great disorder the central plains lacked horses; Turk markets supplied cattle and horses for state use.

sentences.zh: 俄而劉武周將宋金剛來寇太原，屬城皆沒。

translations.literal: Shortly Liu Wuzhou's general Song Jingang came to raid Taiyuan and dependent cities were all lost.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Liu Wuzhou's general Song Jingang raided Taiyuan and dependent cities fell.

sentences.zh: 真鄉公李仲文退守浩州，城孤兵弱，元吉遣文恪率步騎千餘助為聲援。

translations.literal: True Village Duke Li Zhongwen held Haozhou with isolated city and weak troops; Yuanji sent Wenge with more than a thousand foot and horse to help as vocal support.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhongwen held Haozhou with a lone city and weak force; Yuanji sent Wenge with a thousand foot and horse as relief.

sentences.zh: 及太原為賊所陷，文恪遂棄城遁去，坐是賜死獄中。

translations.literal: When Taiyuan fell to the bandits, Wenge abandoned the city and fled; for this he was sentenced to death in prison.
translations.idiomatic: When Taiyuan fell Wenge abandoned the city and fled; he was sentenced to death in prison.

sentences.zh: 張平高張平高，綏州膚施人也。

translations.literal: Zhang Pinggao. Zhang Pinggao was a man of Fushi in Sui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Pinggao came from Fushi in Sui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隋末，為鷹揚府校尉，戍太原，為高祖所識，因參謀議。

translations.literal: At the end of Sui he was Captain of the Hawk-Promotion Directorate, garrisoning Taiyuan; Gaozu knew him and therefore took him into counsel.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Sui he was Captain of the Hawk-Promotion Directorate at Taiyuan; Gaozu knew him and took him into counsel.

sentences.zh: 義旗建，以為軍頭。

translations.literal: When the righteous banner was raised he was made Army Head.
translations.idiomatic: When the righteous banner rose he was made Army Head.

sentences.zh: 從平京城，累授左領軍將軍，封蕭國公。

translations.literal: Following the pacification of the capital he was repeatedly made Left Army General and enfeoffed Duke of Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: After the capital fell he rose to Left Army General and Duke of Xiao.

sentences.zh: 貞觀初，出為丹州刺史，坐事免，令以右光祿大夫還第，卒。

translations.literal: In early Zhenguan he went out as Prefect of Dan Prefecture; for an offense he was dismissed and ordered to return home as Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; he died.
translations.idiomatic: In early Zhenguan he was Prefect of Dan, was dismissed for an offense, sent home as Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and died.

sentences.zh: 後改封羅國公。

translations.literal: Later his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Luo.
translations.idiomatic: Later his title was changed to Duke of Luo.

sentences.zh: 永徽中，追贈潭州都督。

translations.literal: In the Yonghui era he was posthumously made Area Commander of Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yonghui era he was posthumously made Area Commander of Tan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 李思行李思行，趙州人也。

translations.literal: Li Sixing. Li Sixing was a man of Zhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sixing came from Zhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嘗避仇太原。

translations.literal: He once fled a feud to Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He once fled a blood feud to Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 高祖將舉義兵，令赴京城觀覘動靜，及還，具論機變，深稱旨，授左三統軍。

translations.literal: When Gaozu was about to raise the righteous army he sent him to the capital to observe movements; on return he fully explained changes and opportunities and was deeply praised, appointed Left Third Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu was about to rise he sent Sixing to the capital to observe; on return his report pleased Gaozu deeply and he was made Left Third Army Commander.

sentences.zh: 從破宋老生，平京城，累授嘉州刺史，封樂安郡公。

translations.literal: Following the defeat of Song Laosheng and pacification of the capital he was repeatedly made Prefect of Jia Prefecture and enfeoffed Duke of Le'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: After defeating Song Laosheng and taking the capital he became Prefect of Jia and Duke of Le'an Commandery.

sentences.zh: 永徽初卒，贈洪州都督，謚曰襄。

translations.literal: In early Yonghui he died; posthumously made Area Commander of Hong Prefecture with posthumous title Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in early Yonghui and was posthumously made Area Commander of Hong with posthumous title Xiang.

sentences.zh: 李高遷李高遷，岐州岐山人也。

translations.literal: Li Gaogian. Li Gaogian was a man of Qishan in Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gaogian came from Qishan in Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隋末，客遊太原，高祖常引之左右。

translations.literal: At the end of Sui he traveled as guest to Taiyuan; Gaozu often kept him at his side.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Sui he was a guest at Taiyuan; Gaozu often kept him close.

sentences.zh: 及擒高君雅、王威等，高遷有功焉，授右三統軍。

translations.literal: When Gao Junya and Wang Wei were seized, Gaogian had merit and was made Right Third Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Junya and Wei were seized Gaogian had merit and was made Right Third Army Commander.

sentences.zh: 從平霍邑，圍京城，力戰功最，累遷左武衛大將軍，封江夏郡公，檢校西麟州刺史。

translations.literal: Following the pacification of Huoyi and siege of the capital, his battle merit was foremost; he was repeatedly made Left Martial Guard General, Duke of Jiangxia Commandery, and Acting Inspector of Western Lin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the pacification of Huoyi and siege of the capital his battle merit was foremost; he rose to Left Martial Guard General, Duke of Jiangxia, and Acting Inspector of Western Lin.

sentences.zh: 武德初，突厥寇馬邑，朔州總管高滿政請救，高祖令高遷督兵助鎮。

translations.literal: In early Wude the Turks raided Mayi; Shuo Prefecture Area Commander Gao Manzheng requested rescue; Gaozu ordered Gaogian to supervise troops to aid the garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In early Wude Turks raided Mayi; Shuo Area Commander Gao Manzheng sought rescue; Gaozu sent Gaogian to reinforce him.

sentences.zh: 俄而賊兵甚盛，高遷乃斬關宵遁，其將士皆沒，竟坐除名徙邊。

translations.literal: Shortly the bandit force was very strong; Gaogian broke the pass and fled by night—his officers and soldiers were all lost; in the end he was dismissed and exiled to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy grew strong; Gaogian broke out by night and lost his force; he was dismissed and exiled to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 後以佐命功，拜陵州刺史。

translations.literal: Later, for merit in aiding the founding, he was made Prefect of Ling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later, for founding merit, he was made Prefect of Ling.

sentences.zh: 永徽五年卒，贈梁州都督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yonghui he died; posthumously made Area Commander of Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Yonghui year 5 and was posthumously made Area Commander of Liang.

sentences.zh: 許世緒許世緒者，并州人也。

translations.literal: Xu Shiji. Xu Shiji was a man of Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shiji came from Bing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大業末，為鷹揚府司馬。

translations.literal: At the end of the Daye era he was Major of the Hawk-Promotion Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Daye he was Major of the Hawk-Promotion Directorate.

sentences.zh: 見隋祚將亡，言於高祖曰：「天道輔德，人事與能，蹈機不發，必貽後悔。

translations.literal: Seeing Sui fortune about to perish, he said to Gaozu: "Heaven's Way assists virtue and human affairs follow ability; miss the moment and you will surely regret it.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Sui doomed, he told Gaozu: "Heaven assists virtue and men follow ability; miss the moment and you will regret it.

sentences.zh: 今隋政不綱，天下鼎沸，公姓當圖籙，名應歌謠，握五都之兵，當四戰之地。

translations.literal: Now Sui government lacks the cord; the realm boils like a cauldron; your surname answers the charts, your name the songs; you hold the troops of five capitals and stand where four battles meet.
translations.idiomatic: "Sui government is broken, the realm boils, your surname answers the prophecies, your name the songs; you hold the five capitals' troops where four battles meet.

sentences.zh: 若遂無他計，當敗不旋踵。

translations.literal: If you still have no other plan, defeat will come without turning the heel.
translations.idiomatic: "Hesitate further and defeat comes without turning back.

sentences.zh: 未若首建義旗，為天下唱，此帝王業也。

translations.literal: Better first to raise the righteous banner and lead the realm—this is the emperor's enterprise."
translations.idiomatic: "Better raise the righteous banner first and lead the realm—this is an emperor's work."

sentences.zh: 」高祖甚奇之，親顧日厚。

translations.literal: Gaozu marveled at him and day by day regarded him more closely.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu marveled at him and drew him closer day by day.

sentences.zh: 義兵起，授右一府司馬。

translations.literal: When the righteous army rose he was made Right First Directorate Major.
translations.idiomatic: When the righteous army rose he was made Right First Directorate Major.

sentences.zh: 武德中，累除蔡州刺史，封真定郡公，卒。

translations.literal: In Wude he was repeatedly made Prefect of Cai and enfeoffed Duke of Zhending Commandery; he died.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wude he rose to Prefect of Cai and Duke of Zhending Commandery, then died.

sentences.zh: 弟洛仁，亦以元從功臣至冠軍大將軍、行左監門將軍。

translations.literal: His younger brother Luoren also, as an original follower with merit, reached Champion General and Acting Left Gate Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Luoren, also a founding follower, reached Champion General and Acting Left Gate Guard General.

sentences.zh: 永徽初卒，贈代州都督，謚曰勇，陪葬昭陵。

translations.literal: In early Yonghui he died; posthumously made Area Commander of Dai Prefecture with posthumous title Yong, buried with honor at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: He died in early Yonghui, was posthumously made Area Commander of Dai with posthumous title Yong, and buried at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 劉師立劉師立者，宋州虞城人也。

translations.literal: Liu Shili. Liu Shili was a man of Yucheng in Song Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shili came from Yucheng in Song Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初為王世充將軍，親遇甚密。

translations.literal: At first he was a general of Wang Shichong and was treated with deep intimacy.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a general of Wang Shichong and was treated with deep favor.

sentences.zh: 洛陽平，當誅；

translations.literal: When Luoyang was pacified he should have been executed;
translations.idiomatic: When Luoyang fell he should have been executed;

sentences.zh: 太宗惜其才，特免之，為左親衛。

translations.literal: Taizong prized his talent and specially spared him, making him Left Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong prized his talent and spared him, making him Left Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 太宗之謀建成、元吉也，嘗引師立密籌其事，或自宵達曙。

translations.literal: When Taizong plotted against the Hidden Crown Prince Jiancheng and Prince Yuanji, he often drew Shili into secret planning, sometimes from night until dawn.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong plotted against Crown Prince Jiancheng and Prince Yuanji he often drew Shili into secret counsel, sometimes from night until dawn.

sentences.zh: 其後師立與尉遲敬德、龐卿惲、李孟嘗等九人，同誅建成有功，超拜左衛率。

translations.literal: Later Shili with Yuchi Jingde, Pang Qingyun, Li Mengchang, and nine others together executed Jiancheng with merit and was advanced to Left Guard Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Later Shili with Yuchi Jingde, Pang Qingyun, Li Mengchang, and nine others killed Jiancheng with merit and was advanced to Left Guard Commander.

sentences.zh: 尋遷左驍衛將軍，封襄武郡公，賜絹五千匹。

translations.literal: Shortly he was transferred to Left Majestic Guard General, Duke of Xiangwu Commandery, and granted five thousand lengths of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly he became Left Majestic Guard General, Duke of Xiangwu Commandery, with five thousand lengths of silk.

sentences.zh: 後人告師立自雲「眼有赤光，體有非常之相，姓氏又應符讖」。

translations.literal: Later someone reported that Shili himself said: "My eyes have red light; my body has an extraordinary aspect; my surname also answers prophecies."
translations.idiomatic: Later someone reported Shili had said: "My eyes show red light, my body an extraordinary aspect, and my surname answers the prophecies."

sentences.zh: 太宗謂之曰：「人言卿欲反，如何？

translations.literal: Taizong told him: "People say you wish to rebel—how is it?
translations.idiomatic: Taizong asked him: "People say you mean to rebel—how is that?"

sentences.zh: 」師立大懼，俯而對曰：「臣任隋朝，不過六品，身材駑下，不敢輒希富貴。

translations.literal: Shili was greatly afraid, bowed his head and replied: "Your servant served Sui and reached no more than sixth rank; my person is slow and low—I dared not hope for wealth and honor.
translations.idiomatic: Shili was terrified and bowed: "In Sui I reached only sixth rank; I am slow and lowly and dared not hope for wealth.

sentences.zh: 過蒙非常之遇，常以性命許國。

translations.literal: Passing your extraordinary favor, I always pledged my life to the state.
translations.idiomatic: "By your extraordinary favor I pledged my life to the state.

sentences.zh: 而陛下功成事立，臣復致位將軍，顧己循躬，實逾涯分，臣是何人，輒敢言反！

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty's achievement is complete and affairs settled; your servant again reaches the rank of general—looking back on myself, it truly exceeds the limit—what sort of man am I that I dare speak of rebellion!
translations.idiomatic: "Now your achievement is complete and I am a general—looking at myself, it exceeds all bounds—what man am I to speak of rebellion!"

sentences.zh: 」太宗笑曰：「知卿不然，此妄言耳。

translations.literal: Taizong laughed and said: "I know you are not so—this is a false report."
translations.idiomatic: Taizong laughed: "I know you are not—this is slander."

sentences.zh: 」賜帛六十匹，延入臥內慰諭之。

translations.literal: He granted sixty lengths of silk and received him in the sleeping chamber to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: He granted sixty lengths of silk and received him in the sleeping chamber to reassure him.

sentences.zh: 羅藝之反也，長安人情騷動，以師立檢校右武候大將軍，以備非常。

translations.literal: When Luo Yi's rebellion occurred, Chang'an popular feeling was disturbed; Shili was made Acting Right Martial Guard General to guard against the extraordinary.
translations.idiomatic: When Luo Yi rebelled, Chang'an was unsettled; Shili was made Acting Right Martial Guard General against emergency.

sentences.zh: 及藝平，憲司窮究黨與，師立坐與交通，遂除名。

translations.literal: When Yi was pacified, the censorate thoroughly investigated his partisans; Shili was punished for communicating with them and removed from name.
translations.idiomatic: When Yi was pacified the censorate investigated partisans; Shili was punished for contact and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 又以籓邸之舊，尋檢校岐州都督。

translations.literal: Again, because of old ties to the prince's residence, he was shortly made Acting Area Commander of Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: For old ties to the prince's residence he was soon made Acting Area Commander of Qi.

sentences.zh: 師立上書請討吐谷渾，書奏未報，便遣使間其部落，諭以利害，多有降附，列其地為開、橋二州。

translations.literal: Shili memorialized requesting a campaign against Tuyuhun; before the memorial was answered he sent envoys to sound their tribes, explaining advantage and harm—many submitted, and he listed their lands as Kai and Qiao prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Shili asked to campaign against Tuyuhun; before an answer came he sent envoys to sound the tribes, and many submitted; he organized their lands as Kai and Qiao prefectures.

sentences.zh: 又有党項首領拓拔赤辭，先附吐谷渾，負險自固，師立亦遣人為陳利害，赤辭遂率其種落內屬。

translations.literal: There was also Tangut chief Tuohe Chici, who had first attached to Tuyuhun and relied on danger to hold himself firm; Shili also sent men to explain advantage and harm, and Chici then led his clans to submit within.
translations.idiomatic: Tangut chief Tuohe Chici, once attached to Tuyuhun, held rugged ground; Shili's envoys persuaded him and he led his clans to submit.

sentences.zh: 太宗甚嘉之，拜赤辭為西戎州都督。

translations.literal: Taizong greatly praised this and made Chici Area Commander of Western Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong praised this and made Chici Area Commander of Western Rong.

sentences.zh: 後師立以母憂當去職，父老上表請留，詔不許赴哀，復令居任。

translations.literal: Later, when Shili should have left office for his mother's mourning, the elders submitted a memorial asking him to remain; an edict did not permit him to observe mourning and again ordered him to stay in post.
translations.idiomatic: When he should have left for his mother's mourning, elders petitioned to keep him; an edict denied mourning leave and kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 時河西党項破刃氏常為邊患，又阻新附，師立總兵擊之。

translations.literal: At that time the Tangut Poren clan of Hexi often harried the border and also obstructed the newly submitted; Shili gathered troops to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: The Tangut Poren of Hexi harried the border and obstructed new submissions; Shili gathered troops against them.

sentences.zh: 軍未至，破刃氏大懼，遁於山谷，師立追之，至恤於真山而還。

translations.literal: Before the army arrived the Poren were greatly afraid and fled into mountain valleys; Shili pursued to Mount Xuyuzhen and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Before the army arrived the Poren fled into the hills; Shili pursued to Mount Xuyuzhen and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾於小莫門川擊破之，多所虜獲。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun struck them at Xiaomumen River and broke them, taking many captives.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun struck them at Xiaomumen River, broke them, and took many captives.

sentences.zh: 尋轉始州刺史。

translations.literal: Shortly he was transferred to Prefect of Shi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly he became Prefect of Shi.

sentences.zh: 十四年卒，謚曰肅。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he died; posthumous title Su.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 he died with posthumous title Su.

sentences.zh: 錢九隴錢九隴，本晉陵人也，父在陳為境上所獲，沒為皇家隸人。

translations.literal: Qian Jiulong. Qian Jiulong was originally of Jinling; his father was captured on the border under Chen and enslaved as a household servant of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Jiulong was originally from Jinling; his father was captured on the Chen border and enslaved to the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 九隴善騎射，高祖信愛之，常置左右。

translations.literal: Jiulong was skilled at riding and shooting; Gaozu trusted and loved him and often kept him at his side.
translations.idiomatic: Jiulong excelled at riding and archery; Gaozu trusted him and kept him close.

sentences.zh: 義兵起，以軍功授金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: When the righteous army rose he was made Golden-Purple Grand Master of Splendid Happiness for military merit.
translations.idiomatic: When the righteous army rose he was made Golden-Purple Grand Master of Splendid Happiness for military merit.

sentences.zh: 及克京城，拜左監門郎將。

translations.literal: When the capital was taken he was made Left Gate Guard Colonel.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital was taken he became Left Gate Guard Colonel.

sentences.zh: 從平薛仁杲、劉武周，以前後戰功累授右武衛將軍。

translations.literal: He followed the pacification of Xue Rengao and Liu Wuzhou and, for successive battle merit, was repeatedly made Right Martial Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the pacification of Xue Rengao and Liu Wuzhou and rose to Right Martial Guard General.

sentences.zh: 其後從太宗擒獲竇建德，平王世充；

translations.literal: Afterward he followed Taizong in capturing Dou Jiande and pacifying Wang Shichong;
translations.idiomatic: He followed Taizong in capturing Dou Jiande and pacifying Wang Shichong;

sentences.zh: 從隱太子討劉黑闥於魏州，力戰破賊，策勳為最。

translations.literal: he followed the Hidden Crown Prince in campaigning against Liu Heita at Wei Prefecture, fought fiercely and broke the bandits, his merit rating foremost.
translations.idiomatic: he followed the Hidden Crown Prince against Liu Heita at Wei, fought fiercely, broke the rebels, and ranked first in merit.

sentences.zh: 累封郇國公，仍以本官為苑游將軍。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly enfeoffed Duke of Xun and still held his original office as Park Excursion General.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed Duke of Xun and kept his post as Park Excursion General.

sentences.zh: 貞觀初，出為眉州刺史，再遷右監門大將軍。

translations.literal: In early Zhenguan he went out as Prefect of Mei and was again transferred to Right Gate Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: In early Zhenguan he was Prefect of Mei, then Right Gate Guard General.

sentences.zh: 十二年，改封郇國公，加食廬州實封六百戶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Xun with an added substantive fief of six hundred households in Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 his title was changed to Duke of Xun with six hundred added households in Lu.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，贈左武衛大將軍、潭州都督，謚曰勇，陪葬獻陵。

translations.literal: Shortly he died; posthumously made Left Martial Guard General and Area Commander of Tan with posthumous title Yong, buried with honor at Xianling.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died, posthumously Left Martial Guard General and Area Commander of Tan with posthumous title Yong, buried at Xianling.

sentences.zh: 樊興樊興者，本安陸人也，父犯罪，配沒為皇家隸人。

translations.literal: Fan Xing. Fan Xing was originally of Anlu; his father committed a crime and was enslaved as a household servant of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Xing was originally from Anlu; his father offended and was enslaved to the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 興從平京城，累除右監門將軍。

translations.literal: Xing followed the pacification of the capital and was repeatedly made Right Gate Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Xing followed the pacification of the capital and rose to Right Gate Guard General.

sentences.zh: 又從太宗破薛舉，平王世充、竇建德，積戰功，累封營國公，賜物二千段、黃金三十鋌。

translations.literal: He again followed Taizong in defeating Xue Ju and pacifying Wang Shichong and Dou Jiande; for accumulated battle merit he was repeatedly enfeoffed Duke of Ying and granted two thousand lengths of goods and thirty ingots of gold.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Taizong against Xue Ju and in pacifying Wang Shichong and Dou Jiande; for merit he was Duke of Ying with two thousand lengths of goods and thirty gold ingots.

sentences.zh: 尋坐事削爵。

translations.literal: Shortly he was punished by removal of title for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly he lost his title for an offense.

sentences.zh: 貞觀六年，陵州獠反，興率兵討之，拜左驍衛將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenguan the Liao of Ling Prefecture rebelled; Xing led troops to campaign and was made Left Majestic Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenguan year 6 the Liao of Ling rebelled; Xing campaigned and was made Left Majestic Guard General.

sentences.zh: 又從特進李靖擊吐谷渾，為赤水道行軍總管，坐遲留不赴軍期，又士卒多死，失亡甲仗，以勳減死。

translations.literal: He again followed Special Advance Li Jing in striking Tuyuhun as Commander on the Red Water Route; he was punished for delay in not reaching army deadline, many soldiers dying, and losing armor and weapons—his merit reduced the death sentence.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Li Jing against Tuyuhun as Commander on the Red Water Route; delay, heavy losses, and lost arms reduced his death sentence by merit.

sentences.zh: 久之，累拜左監門大將軍，封襄城郡公。

translations.literal: After a long time he was repeatedly made Left Gate Guard General and enfeoffed Duke of Xiangcheng Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: After long service he became Left Gate Guard General and Duke of Xiangcheng Commandery.

sentences.zh: 太宗之征遼東，以興忠謹，令副司空房玄齡，留守京師。

translations.literal: When Taizong campaigned against Liaodong, because Xing was loyal and careful he was ordered to assist Minister of Works Fang Xuanling in remaining to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong campaigned against Liaodong, Xing's loyalty earned him appointment to assist Fang Xuanling in guarding the capital.

sentences.zh: 俄又檢校右武候將軍。

translations.literal: Shortly he was again made Acting Right Martial Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly he was again Acting Right Martial Guard General.

sentences.zh: 永徽初卒，贈左武候大將軍、洪州都督，陪葬獻陵。

translations.literal: In early Yonghui he died; posthumously made Left Martial Guard General and Area Commander of Hong, buried with honor at Xianling.
translations.idiomatic: In early Yonghui he died, posthumously Left Martial Guard General and Area Commander of Hong, buried at Xianling.

sentences.zh: 公孫武達公孫武達者，雍州櫟陽人也。

translations.literal: Gongsun Wuda. Gongsun Wuda was a man of Liyang in Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsun Wuda came from Liyang in Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少有膂力，稱為豪俠。

translations.literal: In youth he had physical strength and was called a bold hero.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he had great strength and was known as a bold hero.

sentences.zh: 在隋為驍果。

translations.literal: Under Sui he was in the Elite Corps.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui he served in the Elite Corps.

sentences.zh: 武德初，至長春宮請謁太宗，從討劉武周，力戰，功居最。

translations.literal: In early Wude he came to Changchun Palace to request audience with Taizong and followed the campaign against Liu Wuzhou; in fierce fighting his merit stood foremost.
translations.idiomatic: In early Wude he came to Changchun Palace to see Taizong and followed the campaign against Liu Wuzhou; in fierce fighting his merit stood first.

sentences.zh: 又從平王世充、竇建德，累遷秦王府右三軍驃騎，封清水縣公。

translations.literal: He again followed the pacification of Wang Shichong and Dou Jiande and was repeatedly made Flying Cavalry of the Princely Estate's Right Third Army and enfeoffed Duke of Qingshui County.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the pacification of Wang Shichong and Dou Jiande and became Flying Cavalry of the Princely Estate's Right Third Army and Duke of Qingshu County.

sentences.zh: 貞觀初，檢校右監門將軍，尋除肅州刺史。

translations.literal: In early Zhenguan he was made Acting Right Gate Guard General and shortly removed as Prefect of Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In early Zhenguan he was Acting Right Gate Guard General, then Prefect of Su.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，突厥數千騎、輜重萬餘入侵肅州，欲南入吐谷渾。

translations.literal: After more than a year, several thousand Turk horsemen with more than ten thousand loads of baggage invaded Su Prefecture intending to enter Tuyuhun southward.
translations.idiomatic: After a year several thousand Turk horsemen with ten thousand loads of baggage invaded Su intending to enter Tuyuhun from the south.

sentences.zh: 武達領二千人與其精銳相遇，力戰，虜稍卻，急攻之，遂大潰，擠之於張掖河。

translations.literal: Wuda led two thousand men to meet their elite force, fought fiercely, the barbarians slightly retreated, and he pressed the attack—they were utterly routed and driven into the Zhangye River.
translations.idiomatic: Wuda led two thousand against their elite, fought fiercely, pressed the retreating enemy, routed them, and drove them into the Zhangye River.

sentences.zh: 又命軍士於上流以伐渡兵，擊其餘眾，賊半濟，兩岸夾攻之，斬溺略盡。

translations.literal: He also ordered soldiers upstream to strike the crossing troops and hit the remainder; half the bandits were mid-river and attacked from both banks—cut down and drowned, nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: He had men upstream strike those crossing; half were mid-river and both banks attacked them—cut down and drowned, nearly all.

sentences.zh: 璽書慰勉之，拜左監門將軍。

translations.literal: An imperial letter comforted and praised him; he was made Left Gate Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial letter praised him; he was made Left Gate Guard General.

sentences.zh: 後又受詔擊鹽州叛突厥，武達引兵趨靈州，追及之。

translations.literal: Later he again received orders to strike the rebellious Turks of Salt Prefecture; Wuda led troops toward Ling Prefecture and overtook them.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was ordered against rebellious Turks of Salt; Wuda marched toward Ling and overtook them.

sentences.zh: 賊方渡河，見武達至，據河南岸。

translations.literal: The bandits were mid-river; seeing Wuda arrive they held the south bank of the river.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy was crossing; seeing Wuda they held the south bank.

sentences.zh: 武達引兵擊之，斬其渠帥可邏拔扈，餘黨幾盡。

translations.literal: Wuda led troops to strike them, beheading their chieftain Keluobahu; the remainder were nearly all gone.
translations.idiomatic: Wuda attacked, beheaded chieftain Keluobahu, and destroyed the remainder.

sentences.zh: 進封東萊郡公。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Duke of Donglai Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to Duke of Donglai Commandery.

sentences.zh: 永徽中，累授右武衛大將軍。

translations.literal: In the Yonghui era he was repeatedly made Right Martial Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yonghui era he rose to Right Martial Guard General.

sentences.zh: 及卒，高宗廢朝舉哀，贈荊州都督，給東園秘器，陪葬昭陵，謚曰壯。

translations.literal: When he died, Gaozong suspended court and raised lament; posthumously made Area Commander of Jing, given eastern-garden secret implements, buried with honor at Zhaoling with posthumous title Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: At his death Gaozong suspended court and mourned; he was posthumously Area Commander of Jing, given imperial funeral gifts, buried at Zhaoling with posthumous title Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 龐卿惲龐卿惲者，并州太原人。

translations.literal: Pang Qingyun. Pang Qingyun was a man of Taiyuan in Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Qingyun came from Taiyuan in Bing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 從太宗討隱太子有功，累拜右驍衛將軍，封邾國公。

translations.literal: Following Taizong's campaign against the Hidden Crown Prince he had merit and was repeatedly made Right Majestic Guard General and enfeoffed Duke of Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in Taizong's campaign against the Hidden Crown Prince he became Right Majestic Guard General and Duke of Zhu.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，追封濮國公。

translations.literal: Shortly he died; posthumously enfeoffed Duke of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died and was posthumously enfeoffed Duke of Pu.

sentences.zh: 子同善，官至右金吾大將軍。

translations.literal: His son Tongshan reached Right Golden Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: His son Tongshan rose to Right Golden Guard General.

sentences.zh: 同善子承宗，開元初，為太子賓客。

translations.literal: Tongshan's son Chengzong, in early Kaiyuan, was Crown Prince Guest.
translations.idiomatic: Tongshan's son Chengzong was Crown Prince Guest in early Kaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 張長遜張長遜，雍州櫟陽人也。

translations.literal: Zhang Changsun. Zhang Changsun was a man of Liyang in Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Changsun came from Liyang in Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隋代為里長，平陳有功，累至五原郡通守。

translations.literal: Under Sui he was District Elder; pacifying Chen he had merit and was repeatedly transferred to Superintendent of Wuyuan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui he was District Elder; pacifying Chen brought merit and repeated promotion to Superintendent of Wuyuan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 及天下亂，遂附於突厥，號長遜為割利特勒。

translations.literal: When the realm fell into disorder he therefore attached to the Turks, who styled Changsun as Geli Tele.
translations.idiomatic: When the realm fell into chaos he attached to the Turks, who styled him Geli Tele.

sentences.zh: 及義旗建，長遜以郡降，授五原太守，尋除豐州總管。

translations.literal: When the righteous banner was raised, Changsun submitted his commandery in surrender and was made Prefect of Wuyuan, shortly made Area Commander of Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the righteous banner rose Changsun surrendered his commandery and became Prefect of Wuyuan, then Area Commander of Feng.

sentences.zh: 是時梁師都、薛舉請兵於突厥，欲令渡河。

translations.literal: At that time Liang Shidu and Xue Ju requested troops from the Turks, wishing to have them cross the river.
translations.idiomatic: Then Liang Shidu and Xue Ju asked the Turks for troops to cross the river.

sentences.zh: 長遜知之，偽為詔書與莫賀咄設，示知其謀。

translations.literal: Changsun knew it and forged an edict to Mohezhuo She, showing he knew their plot.
translations.idiomatic: Changsun learned of it and forged an edict to Mohezhuo She revealing their plot.

sentences.zh: 突厥乃拒師都等使，高祖嘉之。

translations.literal: The Turks therefore refused Shidu and the others' envoys; Gaozu praised this.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks therefore refused Shidu and the others; Gaozu praised Changsun.

sentences.zh: 武德元年，敕右武候驃騎將軍高靜致幣於始畢可汗，路經豐州，會可汗死，敕於所到處納庫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wude, an edict ordered Right Martial Guard Flying Cavalry General Gao Jing to convey gifts to Shibi Khan; passing Feng Prefecture, the khan happened to die; an edict ordered deposit in the treasury wherever reached.
translations.idiomatic: In Wude year 1, Gao Jing was ordered to convey gifts to Shibi Khan; passing Feng the khan died; an edict ordered the gifts deposited locally.

sentences.zh: 突厥聞而大怒，欲南渡。

translations.literal: The Turks heard it and were greatly angered, wishing to cross south.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks heard and were furious, intending to cross south.

sentences.zh: 長遜乃遣高靜出塞，申國家賻贈之禮，突厥乃引還。

translations.literal: Changsun then sent Gao Jing beyond the passes to explain the state's condolence gifts; the Turks then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Changsun sent Gao Jing beyond the passes to explain the state's condolence gifts; the Turks withdrew.

sentences.zh: 及征薛舉，長遜不待命而至，以功授豐州總管，進封巴國公，賜以錦袍金甲。

translations.literal: When campaigning against Xue Ju, Changsun arrived without awaiting orders; for merit he was made Area Commander of Feng, advanced to Duke of Ba, and granted brocade robes and golden armor.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning against Xue Ju, Changsun came without awaiting orders; for merit he was Area Commander of Feng, Duke of Ba, with brocade robes and golden armor.

sentences.zh: 是時言事者以長遜久居豐州，與突厥連結；

translations.literal: At that time those who spoke on affairs said Changsun had long held Feng and was linked with the Turks;
translations.idiomatic: Court gossips said Changsun had long held Feng and was linked to the Turks;

sentences.zh: 長遜懼，請入朝，拜右武候將軍，徙封息國公，賜以宮人、彩物千餘段。

translations.literal: Changsun was afraid and requested to enter court; he was made Right Martial Guard General, his enfeoffment changed to Duke of Xi, and granted palace women and more than a thousand lengths of colored goods.
translations.idiomatic: afraid, he requested court; he was made Right Martial Guard General, retitled Duke of Xi, and granted palace women and a thousand lengths of colored goods.

sentences.zh: 會有疾，車駕親幸其第。

translations.literal: When he fell ill the imperial carriage personally visited his residence.
translations.idiomatic: When he fell ill the emperor personally visited his house.

sentences.zh: 及竇軌率巴蜀兵擊王世充，以長遜檢校益州行台左僕射，歷遂、夔二州總管，所在皆有惠政。

translations.literal: When Dou Gui led Ba-Shu troops against Wang Shichong, Changsun was made Acting Left Vice Minister of the Yizhou Route Directorate, successively Area Commander of Sui and Kui—wherever he was, he had benevolent government.
translations.idiomatic: When Dou Gui led Ba-Shu troops against Wang Shichong, Changsun was Acting Left Vice Minister on the Yizhou Route, then Area Commander of Sui and Kui—wherever he served, his rule was benevolent.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十一年卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhenguan he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Zhenguan year 11.

sentences.zh: 李安遠李安遠者，夏州朔方人也。

translations.literal: Li Anyuan. Li Anyuan was a man of Shuofang in Xia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Anyuan came from Shuofang in Xia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隋雲州刺史徹子也。

translations.literal: He was the son of Sui Cloud Prefecture Inspector Che.
translations.idiomatic: He was the son of Sui Cloud Prefecture Inspector Che.

sentences.zh: 家富於財，少從博徒不逞，晚始折節讀書，敬慕士友。

translations.literal: The family was rich in wealth; in youth he followed gamblers and unruly men, only in later years beginning to restrain himself in study and respect scholars and friends.
translations.idiomatic: His family was wealthy; in youth he ran with gamblers and ruffians, turning to study and respectable company only later.

sentences.zh: 襲父爵城陽公。

translations.literal: He inherited his father's rank as Duke of Chengyang.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited his father's rank as Duke of Chengyang.

sentences.zh: 與王珪友善。

translations.literal: He was friendly with Wang Gui.
translations.idiomatic: He was friendly with Wang Gui.

sentences.zh: 大業初，珪坐叔頗當配流，安遠為之營護，免。

translations.literal: In early Daye, Wang Gui was punished because his uncle was sentenced to exile; Anyuan managed his protection and secured his release.
translations.idiomatic: In early Daye Wang Gui was punished when an uncle was sentenced to exile; Anyuan protected him and secured his release.

sentences.zh: 後為正平令。

translations.literal: Later he became Magistrate of Zhengping.
translations.idiomatic: Later he became Magistrate of Zhengping.

sentences.zh: 及義兵攻絳郡，安遠與通守陳叔達嬰城自守。

translations.literal: When the righteous army attacked Jiang Commandery, Anyuan with Superintendent Chen Shuda defended the city and held firm.
translations.idiomatic: When the righteous army attacked Jiang Commandery, Anyuan and Superintendent Chen Shuda held the city firm.

sentences.zh: 城陷，高祖與安遠有舊，馳至其宅撫慰之，引與同食。

translations.literal: When the city fell, Gaozu was old friends with Anyuan, rode to his residence to comfort him, and drew him to eat together.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell Gaozu, an old friend, rode to comfort him and ate with him.

sentences.zh: 拜右翊衛統軍，封正平縣公。

translations.literal: He was made Right Wing Guard Commander and enfeoffed Duke of Zhengping County.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Right Wing Guard Commander and Duke of Zhengping County.

sentences.zh: 武德元年，授右武衛大將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wude he was appointed Right Martial Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: In Wude year 1 he was appointed Right Martial Guard General.

sentences.zh: 從太宗征伐，特蒙恩澤，累戰功，改封廣德郡公。

translations.literal: Following Taizong in campaigns he was specially favored; for accumulated battle merit his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Guangde Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Following Taizong in campaigns he was specially favored; for merit his title became Duke of Guangde Commandery.

sentences.zh: 又使於吐谷渾，與敦和好，於是吐谷渾主伏允請與中國互市，安遠之功也。

translations.literal: He was also sent as envoy to Tuyuhun and secured friendly relations; thereby Tuyuhun's ruler Fuyun requested mutual markets with China—this was Anyuan's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Sent as envoy to Tuyuhun he secured friendship; Fuyun then requested trade with China—Anyuan's achievement.

sentences.zh: 後隱太子建成潛引以為黨援，安遠固拒之，由是太宗益加親信。

translations.literal: Later the Hidden Crown Prince Jiancheng secretly drew him as partisan support; Anyuan firmly refused—therefore Taizong trusted him still more.
translations.idiomatic: Later Crown Prince Jiancheng secretly tried to enlist him; Anyuan refused firmly—so Taizong trusted him more.

sentences.zh: 貞觀初，歷潞州都督、懷州刺史。

translations.literal: In early Zhenguan he was successively Area Commander of Lu and Prefect of Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In early Zhenguan he was Area Commander of Lu, then Prefect of Huai.

sentences.zh: 歷任頗有聲績，然傷於嚴急，時論少之。

translations.literal: In successive posts he had reputation and achievement, yet he harmed through severity and urgency—contemporary opinion slighted this.
translations.idiomatic: In office he earned reputation, yet his severity drew criticism.

sentences.zh: 七年卒，追贈涼州都督，謚曰密。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he died; posthumously made Area Commander of Liang with posthumous title Mi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he died, posthumously Area Commander of Liang with posthumous title Mi.

sentences.zh: 十三年，追封為遂安郡公。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was posthumously advanced to Duke of Sui'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he was posthumously advanced to Duke of Sui'an Commandery.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰史臣曰：裴寂歷任仕隋，官至為宮監，總子女玉帛之務，據倉廩兵甲之饒，喜博戲之利苟多，啟舉義之謀為首。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: The historiographer says: Pei Ji successively served under Sui, reaching the post of palace superintendent, overseeing the affair of sons and daughters, jade, and silks, holding stores of granaries and armor in abundance, delighting in the profit of gambling, and opening the plan of the righteous rising as foremost.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: Pei Ji served Sui to palace superintendent, overseeing palace women and treasure, holding granaries and armor, delighting in gambling profit, and opening the righteous rising as foremost.

sentences.zh: 謁岳神以徼福，始彰不逞之心；

translations.literal: He visited the mountain god to beg fortune—at first manifesting a heart that would not submit;
translations.idiomatic: He prayed at the mountain shrine for fortune—first showing a heart that would not submit;

sentences.zh: 留貴妃以經宿，終昧為臣之道。

translations.literal: he kept imperial consorts overnight—at last obscuring the way of the minister.
translations.idiomatic: he kept imperial consorts overnight—at last forgetting the minister's way.

sentences.zh: 居第一之位，乏在三之規。

translations.literal: Occupying the first place, he lacked the rule of the third.
translations.idiomatic: He held first place yet lacked the discipline of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 恃高祖之舊恩，致文靜之極法。

translations.literal: Relying on Gaozu's old favor, he brought Wenjing to extreme law.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on Gaozu's old favor, he drove Wenjing to the extreme penalty.

sentences.zh: 終歸四罪，尚保再生，幸也。

translations.literal: In the end he returned with four crimes yet still kept rebirth—fortunate indeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the end charged with four crimes yet still kept his life—fortunate indeed.

sentences.zh: 文靜奮縱橫之略，立締構之功，罔思寵辱之機，過為輕躁之行，未及封而禍也，惜哉！

translations.literal: Wenjing exerted a strategist's design and established the merit of founding the structure; he did not reflect on the mechanism of favor and disgrace and passed into reckless conduct—before enfeoffment came calamity; pitiable!
translations.idiomatic: Wenjing exerted a strategist's design and helped found the structure; heedless of favor and disgrace he grew reckless—calamity before his reward was complete; pitiable!

sentences.zh: 凡關佐命，爰第實封，小大不遺，賢愚自勸，太宗之行賞也，明矣！

translations.literal: As for all who aided the mandate, loving rank with graded substantive fiefs, none great or small omitted, worthy and foolish each encouraged—Taizong's bestowal of rewards was manifest!
translations.idiomatic: As for all who aided the mandate, graded fiefs for great and small alike, worthy and foolish each encouraged—Taizong's rewards were manifest!

sentences.zh: 贊曰：風雲初合，共竭智力。

translations.literal: Praise says: When wind and cloud first joined, together they exhausted mind and strength.
translations.idiomatic: Praise says: When wind and cloud first joined, together they exhausted mind and strength.

sentences.zh: 勢利既分，遽變仇敵。

translations.literal: Once advantage and rank were divided, they swiftly changed into enemies.
translations.idiomatic: Once advantage and rank were divided, they swiftly became enemies.
